interpretation: A categorical operational summary of current structured threat anticipation. It is not a 0-100 emotion score and does not estimate subjective magnitude.

scientific_conceptual_basis.title: Assessing fear and anxiety in humans using the threat of predictable and unpredictable aversive events (the NPU-threat test)
scientific_conceptual_basis.use: Supports separating predictable, signalled threat from sustained unpredictable threat; it does not supply a software intensity scale.

scientific_conceptual_basis.title: Temporal Dynamics of Uncertainty Cause Anxiety and Avoidance
scientific_conceptual_basis.use: Supports keeping temporal uncertainty and event timing explicit, and calculating hazard only from a real event-time distribution rather than collapsing timing into an affect score.

state_rules.QUIET: No active current defensive context exists.
state_rules.ANTICIPATING: At least one active context has POTENTIAL or UNKNOWN temporal status and none is imminent or ongoing.
state_rules.THREAT_IMMINENT: At least one active context is IMMINENT and none is ONGOING.
state_rules.THREAT_ONGOING: At least one active context is ONGOING.
state_rules.UNKNOWN: The authoritative current defensive-context state is unavailable.

concurrent_contexts: Every context and adverse outcome remains independent. Precedence selects only the public headline; it never sums or merges evidence.

learning.prior_only_rule: Beta(1,1) is a prior and must never be displayed as 50% learned threat.

temporal_hazard.reason: No event-time distribution is produced by the current simulated world.
temporal_hazard.future_interface: A hazard value may be added only when a validated event-time distribution exists.

state_lifecycle: The projection changes only when its persistent authoritative current-defensive-context input changes. No decay or interpolation is applied.

engineering_constants.name: state_schema_version
engineering_constants.classification: storage and API compatibility; not a psychological parameter

behavioural_boundary: The operational headline is public presentation. Existing underlying grounded defensive facts continue to enter prose and model-mediated expressive choice; this projection adds no instruction, action weight, timing, drawing, handwriting or memory effect.
